subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word

Mustafa then proceeded to **__enumerate__** five factors that he believed are contributing to the prevailing despair.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Guess**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enumerate"** means to mention (a number of things) one by one; to list. (गिनाना)

 
 
• **Example: **She **enumerated** the many obstacles she had encountered during her career.
 
 
 
• **"Guess" **refers to an estimate or conclusion drawn without sufficient information to be sure of being correct. (अनुमान)
 
 
• **Example: **He **guessed** the answer to the question because he was unsure.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'enumerate' **is **'guess'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Detail **(विस्तार): To describe item by item; to give specifics.

 
 
• **Example:** The report details the steps taken to improve the system.
 
 
 
• **Specify **(निर्दिष्ट करना): To identify clearly and definitely.
 
 
• **Example: **Please specify the time and place of the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Calculate** (गणना करना): To determine (the amount or number of something) mathematically.
 
 
• **Example:** She calculated the total cost of the project.
 
 

 

32:Tb83,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
